# `Character.toTitleCase(char)` for every BMP code point either case map
# touches -- `toTitleCase(c) != c` OR `toUpperCase(c) != c`.
#
# W2 Task 8, fix round 3. Round 2 dumped only `toTitleCase(c) != c`, and that
# fixture is blind BY CONSTRUCTION to a code point whose title case IS itself
# while its uppercase is not: those fall through to the uppercase fallback and
# come out wrong. 50 of them did -- the four already-title-case digraphs and
# the whole Georgian Mkhedruli block -- and the test guarding the derivation
# could not see them, because its identity half asserted
# `java_title_case(c) == c.to_uppercase()`, which is the implementation's own
# fallback arm restated.
#
# `<from>:<to>` in upper-case hex, comma-separated, 1199 entries. Regenerated
# with, on the pinned Corretto 25:
#
#   for (int c = 0; c <= 0xFFFF; c++) {
#       int t = Character.toTitleCase((char) c), u = Character.toUpperCase((char) c);
#       if (t != c || u != c) out(String.format("%X:%X,", c, t));
#   }
#
# Nothing outside the BMP can appear: `toTitleCase(char)` takes a `char`.
